construction.KhoReadContext.tu_dict: Only trusted repository/root-DEMO harness; never native/browser. Reject malformed container/types or unknown keys; deep-copy into frozen dataclass/typed nested DTOs. Missing/null/unresolved business references are retained nullable for reader issues/HOLD, never constructor abort or implicit defaults.
construction.KhoHistorySummary.tu_dict: Same trusted boundary. None stays missing; EXPLICIT_EMPTY is a separate valid summary with exact logical/scope/profile identity. Do not mutate input or bind from reader outputs.
construction.KhoReadResult: Construct only by reader; frozen dataclass and nested immutable DTOs. Copy mutable shared fixture.Issue into frozen KhoIssue(code,message,locator,severity); tuple[shared Issue] is not deep immutable. Do not edit shared Issue. No Store/Record/DB/file/API promotion or global cache.
construction.primitive_types: TextId=str nonempty and unchanged by strip; Digest=64 lowercase hex; Version=positive int excluding bool; native JSON Number=int|Decimal excluding bool/float; datetime/date never inferred.
construction.native_missing: Use distinct tagged FrozenObject(entries:tuple[(str,FrozenValue)]) and FrozenArray(items:tuple[FrozenValue]), both frozen dataclasses; FrozenValue=JSON scalar|FrozenObject|FrozenArray. Thus empty object differs from empty array. No mutable dict/list/shared Issue retained. Preserve key absence/null/empty, exact strings/types/order; thaw only for envelope hashing.
construction.context_missing: Business refs/payloads may be absent/null/unresolved without constructor abort: logical, scope, profile, mapping/PN, master, evidence. Return candidate+issue/HOLD. Missing required identity/scope/mapping/PN/profile/master refs or contradictory resolved facts=>request null. Missing logical/master graph also=>semantic null; missing mapping/PN/profile alone preserves valid semantic facts. Optional measurement/proof unknowns alone remain hashable explicit null; normalized quantity stays null/HOLD. No ratio/unit/date default.
construction.digest_rules: Use exact kho10-content/v1 and kho10-request/v1 envelopes from pinned contract; normalize Decimal only inside fingerprint tree; never raw bytes. Malformed native graph => both semantic/request null.
construction.deferred: Product DTO implementation and root acceptance pending; helper definitions prepared but not executed. Actual profile/mapping/proof/deployment NOT_VERIFIED. No M5 dispatch or product PASS.

NativeLine.quantity_text: exact source string or exact numeric token; null stays null

KhoReadContext.required_container: object from trusted tu_dict; absent business fields normalize to null, not invented references

optional.request_digest: literal null compatibility placeholder; current digest is computed by reader, never supplied expected

checks: logical/scope/mapping tuples exact; absent required members yield KHO_CONTEXT_UNRESOLVED, not constructor exception
master raw SHA equals pinned snapshot reference; no semantic SHA alias

resolved payload links source instance/profile and measurement profile exactly; unit ref maps to each referenced native master UOM; declared encoding matches actual quantity kinds; domain38,12 and explicit ratio1/1 checked, not inferred

contradictory resolved facts=>KHO_CONTEXT_PROOF_MISMATCH/HOLD/request null; missing resolved facts alone=>KHO_MEASUREMENT_UNRESOLVED/HOLD/normalized quantity null but request remains hashable when required refs resolve
K01-K07 fixed DEMO declarations only; K08/K09/K10 resolved facts null, optional unknown measurement/proof fields remain hashable explicit null; K06 malformed remains unhashable
hash/replay never grants eligibility or production approval; request identity is separate from precision/UOM/proof eligibility

each accepted/receipt content digest belongs to seen set
every content reference logical tuple matches summary
empty summary has empty receipts/seen/basis and accepted null

NOT_BOUND/null digests in prior state => HISTORY_UNBOUND/HOLD; do not reinterpret raw SHA as semantic SHA

KhoReadResult.malformed: Keep raw SHA + raw/native values and locators where structurally recoverable, issues; semantic/request null; no last-wins, fake date/zero/unit/negative voucher.
KhoReadResult.classification: Separate phan_loai_quan_sat(candidate,summary|None) -> frozen {reason_codes:tuple,needs_review:bool,history_state:KNOWN|UNKNOWN|MISSING}; never mutate candidate/summary/accepted links. History missing or malformed candidate holds, replay does not conceal partial/proof/precision issues.

projection.semantic: Five exact keys in fingerprint contract: contract,logical_source,native_header,ordered_native_lines,related_master_facts; related masters only referenced native keys sorted; exclude mapping/receipt/proof/history/capture metadata.
projection.request: Exact request envelope in fingerprint contract; sections sorted as set, errors sorted unique; conversion_kind explicitly included; optional measurement fields absent->null. Exclude receipt/capture IDs/time/history; native raw SHA remains actual bytes hash.
projection.same_unit: Resolved verified same unit-definition/context + explicit1/1 evidence: conversion proof null is N/A; producer/source proof still unverified outside DEMO. Different-unit null approved proof => UNPROVEN/HOLD.
projection.measurement_gate: Only coherent trusted resolved payload with matching source/measurement profile, immutable unit ref->native unit, declared actual encoding, explicit ratio1/1 and exact38,12 domain permits normalized quantity. Missing/contradictory facts or unproven Number/null/new unit=>normalized quantity null+issue/HOLD. Never derive facts from ID spelling, labels, DVT_QuyDoi or digest match. Request hashing alone grants none of these.
projection.classify: Same receipt+request/content=>REPLAY; receipt digest mismatch=>CONFLICT/HOLD; new receipt+accepted same content=>fresh; acceptedB reversed+seenA,B then A=>REAPPEARANCE_HOLD; retain partial/precision/continuity reasons. No promotion/capacity/budget mutations.
